university.name: Oxford Brookes University
university.summary: Oxford Brookes University is situated in the city of Oxford. The international students page gives its address as Headington Campus, Oxford, OX3 0BP.

courses.title: Project Management
courses.duration_text: 1 year full-time, or 2 years in sandwich mode; part-time also offered
courses.overview: Full-time taught master's open to graduates of any discipline, with a sandwich placement option. Compulsory modules cover project planning, risk, leadership and procurement, followed by an applied project.
courses.academic_requirements: A minimum of a second class honours degree (2:2) in any academic discipline or equivalent; relevant extensive professional experience is also accepted in place of academic qualifications.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS minimum 6.0 with a minimum of 6.0 in reading and writing and 5.5 in listening and speaking. Met automatically by applicants with at least one full year of UK undergraduate study. English page IELTS-equivalent bands: PTE 65, Duolingo 110.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Four-year bachelor's degree required. Direct entry at 2:1 level: 65% or GP 3.0. At 2:2 level: 60% or GPA 2.7. Pre-master's pass grade: 40% or GPA 1.0.
courses.notes: min_ielts_band 5.5 is the lowest component (listening and speaking); reading and writing need 6.0. TOEFL left null because the English page changed TOEFL scoring for tests taken from 21 January 2026. Fee is the first-year fee; sandwich year costs extra (3,275 in 2027/28).

courses.title: Business and Management
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time, or 4 years with work placement; part-time also offered
courses.overview: Full-time honours degree in business and management with an optional placement or study abroad year. Year 1 modules cover finance for managers, international business, entrepreneurship and business in society.
courses.academic_requirements: Standard offer: UCAS Tariff 112; A Level BBC; IB 27; BTEC DMM. Contextual offer: Tariff 88; A Level CCD; IB 24; BTEC MMM. International and recognised foundation qualifications are considered.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with 6.0 in reading and writing and 5.5 in listening and speaking (university band for all other undergraduate courses). IELTS-equivalent bands on the English page: PTE 65, Duolingo 110 (Duolingo accepted only if taken after 1 July 2024 with all four modules).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) with 60% average plus a recognised foundation course. Applicants below the minimum may apply for a foundation course.
courses.notes: Course page does not state English scores; the university's English language requirements page was used (course falls in the all other undergraduate courses band). min_ielts_band 5.5 is the lowest component; reading and writing need 6.0. TOEFL left null because of the January 2026 scoring change. A January 2027 start falls in the 2026/27 fee year (19,700); 2027/28 fee shown as the target year.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time, or 4 years with work placement; part-time also offered
courses.overview: Full-time honours degree in computer science with an optional 12-month industry placement. The page lists compulsory modules in programming, systems, databases and software engineering, and describes British Computer Society accreditation.
courses.academic_requirements: Standard offer: UCAS Tariff 112; A Level BBC; IB 27; BTEC DMM. Contextual offer: Tariff 88; A Level CCD; IB 24; BTEC MMM. GCSE Mathematics and English Language at grade 4/C normally required.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with 6.0 in reading and writing and 5.5 in listening and speaking (university band for all other undergraduate courses). IELTS-equivalent bands on the English page: PTE 65, Duolingo 110 (Duolingo accepted only if taken after 1 July 2024 with all four modules).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) with 60% average plus a recognised foundation course. Applicants below the minimum may apply for a foundation course.
courses.notes: Course page lists only a September 2026 start and no 2027 intake, so intake_labels is empty; 2027/28 international fee of 19,300 is published on the page. Course page does not state English scores; the university English page band for all other undergraduate courses was used. TOEFL left null because of the January 2026 scoring change.

courses.title: International Foundation Business and Technology
courses.duration_text: 1-year foundation (24 weeks) leading to a 3-year undergraduate degree
courses.overview: Full-time foundation course at the Headington campus with guaranteed progression to listed Oxford Brookes degrees on passing the foundation year with 40%. Compulsory modules include academic skills, business fundamentals and economics for business.
courses.academic_requirements: British A-levels: 48 UCAS Tariff points (equivalent to DD), plus GCSE Maths grade 4 or equivalent. Students without this Maths grade take a compulsory Maths and Statistics module. Normally aged 18 or over.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 5.5 overall with 5.5 in all skills, or equivalent (English page bands: PTE 59, Duolingo 100).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page lists HSC 60% overall for an International Foundation Diploma and HSC 70% overall for an integrated four-year foundation programme; it does not name this course, so no percentage is entered as a requirement.
courses.notes: Page lists September 2026 and January 2027 starts only. A January 2027 start falls in the 2026/27 fee year (17,250); 2027/28 fee shown as the target year. Page is inconsistent on the number of compulsory modules (overview says six, module list shows eight). Pakistan percentage not confirmed for this specific course.

scholarships.name: International Student Scholarship, January 2027 entry
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,000 discount on the second semester of tuition fees
scholarships.summary: Discount for privately funded international students who pay their tuition deposit by the stated deadline. Covers new full-time undergraduate degrees and full-time one or two year postgraduate degrees on the listed courses.
scholarships.criteria_text: New, full-time, international fee-paying student funding their studies privately, holding an offer and paying the deposit by 4 December 2026. Not available to sponsored students or where home and overseas fees are the same. Cannot be combined with other Oxford Brookes funding.
scholarships.deadline_note: Deposit deadline; the page refers to a table of deadlines by offer date that did not appear in the extract.
scholarships.notes: Page states January 2027 in key facts but January 2026 in the terms. Eligible course list (about 47 courses) not checked against the courses in this file. September 2027 terms not yet published.

scholarships.name: Oxford Brookes Business School International Student Scholarship, January 2027 entry
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,000 discount on the second semester of tuition fees in each academic year
scholarships.summary: Annual discount for privately funded international students starting selected Oxford Brookes Business School undergraduate degrees in January 2027, subject to a tuition deposit paid by the deadline.
scholarships.criteria_text: New, full-time, international fee-paying student funding studies privately, with an offer to start one of 13 eligible Business School undergraduate degrees in January 2027 and deposit paid by 4 December 2026. Not available to sponsored students or Oxford Brookes foundation progression students.
scholarships.deadline_note: Deposit deadline taken from the overview text.
scholarships.notes: Eligible courses include Accounting and Finance, Business and Management, Economics and Marketing Management. September 2027 terms not yet published.
